name: Lakeway Highlands
title: Lakeway Highlands Window Cleaning, Spot Free | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Lakeway Highlands homes, from new builds to greenbelt lots. Pure water, no streaks, exterior from $10 per window. Text for a quote.
intro: Lakeway Highlands is the newer side of town, with homes from the 2010s to the present on near half acre lots. CleanzATX cleans here regularly, and the large panes common in these plans are exactly what our pure water system is built for.

sections.h2: What Lakeway Highlands homes are like
paragraphs: This is a master planned community built in numbered phases, starting with Phase 1 and its first eight sections. Newer phases added in 2020 came in at 28 lots each, so construction has kept moving for years. The typical plan is four or five bedrooms on a lot close to half an acre, and many back to greenbelt. The Crosswind Drive and Hornsby Bend area is part of the neighborhood. Prices cluster around a median of $860K with plenty reaching $1.5M. Lakeway Highlands HOA covers the community, and there is no gate.

Because homes were built across more than a decade, you find different eras side by side. Early builds are settling into their landscaping while the newest streets still have bare lots, fresh sod and active framing crews. That mix shapes what the glass looks like from one street to the next.

sections.h2: What Lakeway Highlands windows deal with
paragraphs: Construction dust is the first thing to mention. Where lots are still being built, fine dust and drywall powder travel on the wind and settle on glass and screens. New homes also carry sticker residue, paint flecks and stucco splatter from the build. Beyond that, greenbelt lots bring spider webs, leaf debris and pollen. Cedar season runs December to February and live oak pollen follows in March and April.

New builds often have large picture windows and tall stair glass that are hard to reach. Sprinkler spray from half acre lawns also hits lower panes and leaves white spots. Our water runs near 0 TDS, which lets glass dry without leaving film. For mineral spots that have already set, hard water removal is $10 per pane.

Access is easy. There is no gate, so we pull up, set up the pole system and work from the ground to three stories. Water fed poles mean we do not lean ladders on fresh paint or new stucco. For a new build, we suggest a first cleaning once landscaping and sod are in, so dust is not redeposited the next week. After that many owners join a plan. Triannual takes 15% off and includes a yearly free screen cleaning. We route by street, which keeps a Highlands afternoon efficient.

For a 3,500 square foot four bedroom, exterior windows come to about $350, which is our typical home price. Allow roughly two and a half to three and a half hours outside, plus about an hour and three quarters if you want the inside done as well.

why: Large picture glass cleaned from the ground without ladders on new paint.
Post construction dust handled in a way that does not scratch fresh glass.
Greenbelt lots mean extra webs and leaf litter, which we clear from screens.
Plans start at 10% off, so new owners can set a rhythm early.

faq.q: When should I first clean a brand new home?
faq.a: Wait until landscaping and sod are done and nearby construction slows down. Cleaning too early means dust returns within days. If you need it sooner for a move in, we can clean and touch up after.

faq.q: Do you handle the HOA rules here?
faq.a: We work from the street or your driveway and do not leave anything behind. Your HOA rules cover your exterior, not our visit. If your association has a request on timing, just tell us when you text.

faq.q: What about construction dust and paint on the glass?
faq.a: We can remove light paint flecks and stucco splatter with careful scraping and pure water. Heavy cement or etched glass is a separate conversation, and we tell you what we find before we start.

faq.q: How much does a four bedroom here cost?
faq.a: Most come to about $350 for the exterior at $10 per window. Inside and out is $15 per window. Screens are $5 each, and the minimum job is $200. We quote by text, usually within the hour.

faq.q: Can you clean glass facing the greenbelt?
faq.a: Yes. Those windows collect webs and pollen faster than street side glass. Poles let us reach upper panes from the ground, and we brush frames and tracks so the webs do not come right back.
